crossRefs.note: He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here…
Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? You will again see yet greater abominations than these.”
“They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they…
But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

translations.web: He said also to me, “You will again see more of the great abominations which they do.”
translations.bsb: Again, He told me, “You will see them committing even greater abominations.”
translations.kjv: He said also unto me, Turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do.
translations.asv: He said also unto me, Thou shalt again see yet other great abominations which they do.
